reason: I want to make a place to sit and work, and bending the metal stock seems like a useful way to make a frame.
expectation: I expect the brake to shape the stock into a frame or parts for one, though I don't know the exact result.

alternatives.reason: The felt and fabric could make a cushion, but I want to start with the structure.

effect: The brake produced frame sections, which may provide the structure for the sitting and work area.
reaction: The result is about what I expected.
reason: The blocks and frame sections seem like a plausible way to build a stable surface or support.
expectation: I expect them to form part of the furniture, though I’m unsure exactly what.

alternatives.reason: The felt and fabric could make a cushion, but I want to assemble the structure first.

effect: The blocks became feet for a window bench with a seat and worktop, clarifying how the frame forms the sitting and work area.
reaction: The ceramic feet are a satisfying use of the paving blocks.
reason: Combining the felt and fabric is the only offered combination and may make the bare bench more comfortable.
expectation: I expect a cushion or padding, though I don't know whether it will be fitted to the bench yet.

effect: The felt and fabric made a cushion that can now be fitted to the bench.
reaction: That result was expected and makes the next step clear.
reason: The cushion and bench are the only offered combination, and fitting them should make the seat comfortable.
expectation: I expect a cushioned window bench, possibly completing the goal.

effect: Fitting the cushion completed the window bench and the chapter’s goal, giving the cabin a place to sit and work.
reaction: The view of the sunset gives the finished bench a welcome sense of purpose.

mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the frame sections with the paving blocks was most worthwhile: the ceramic feet connected the bench to the earlier workshop floor and made the construction feel tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the cushion was predictable, with only one combination offered at that point.

surprise.text: I had not expected the paving blocks to become feet for a seat-and-worktop frame.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the materials and their uses were understandable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, partly to see how the crops and the expedition develop. This chapter’s practical construction and quiet ending made me curious about life in the cabin.
